autoComputeConstraintFramesFromCurrentPo.description:
Editor-only; has no runtime effect. When on, this constraint's reference frames are recomputed from the current poses of Entity A and B (and this constraint's placement) each time the template is saved: each connected object records where the constraint attaches to it, and the current spacing between the objects becomes the distance its lower and upper limits are measured from. Arrange and place the objects the way you want them held, then save.
Leave one Entity empty to pin the other to its current spot in the world (not the world origin).
Turn off to set the reference frames manually in Entity A's and B's spaces; the constraint always uses the saved frames.
autoComputeConstraintFramesFromCurrentPo.label: Auto Compute Constraint Frames

constraintFrameRotationRelativeToEntityB.description:

lowerLimit.description:
If negative, no lower limit is enforced. If non-negative, this constraint will try to keep the actors
at least this far apart, and if "Upper Limit" is also non-negative, this value must be <= "Upper Limit".
If "Lower Limit" is near 0 and you're seeing jittering or undesired bouncing, try increasing "Tolerance".
lowerLimit.label: Lower Limit

springDamping.description:
If this and "Spring Stiffness" are zero, this constraint's limits are hard and will not be exceeded.
Otherwise, this constraint's limits are soft, and when it is outside of those limits, a spring with this damping coefficient will try to pull it back into those limits.
springDamping.label: Spring Damping

springStiffness.description:
If this and "Spring Damping" are zero, this constraint's limits are hard and will not be exceeded.
Otherwise, this constraint's limits are soft, and when it is outside of those limits, a spring with this stiffness will try to pull it back into those limits.
springStiffness.label: Spring Stiffness

tolerance.description: Distance beyond the limits before the spring starts exerting forces. Try increasing this value if the constraint is bouncing or unstable when "Lower Limit" is near 0.
tolerance.label: Tolerance

upperLimit.description:
If negative, no upper limit is enforced. If non-negative, this constraint will try to keep the actors
within this distance of each other, and if "Lower Limit" is also non-negative, this value must be >= "Lower Limit".
upperLimit.label: Upper Limit

erosionCellScale.description: Scale multiplier for Phacelle noise cells. Controls the size of the underlying stripe-based noise cells used to generate the erosion pattern. Larger values produce wider, more spaced-out gully patterns.

erosionDetail.description: Controls how the erosion mask combines between FBM octaves. Higher values preserve more detail from each octave, lower values create smoother blending. Affects the sharpness of gully edges across scales.

erosionFadeTarget.description: Target value that gullies fade toward in flat areas where the onset mask is low. Controls the baseline displacement in areas without strong erosion. Range: -1 to 1. 0 = no displacement in flat areas.

erosionGain.description: Amplitude multiplier applied per octave. Controls how much weaker each successive detail layer is. A value of 0.5 means each octave has half the displacement strength of the previous.

erosionGradientWidth.description: Width of the gradient sampling kernel in texels. Controls how the terrain slope is computed for slope-dependent erosion. Larger values smooth out per-texel noise in the slope computation, producing cleaner gully directions.
erosionGradientWidth.label: Gradient width

erosionGullyWeight.description: How much completed gullies steer the slope direction for subsequent FBM octaves. Higher values create more coherent, connected gully networks where small channels flow into larger ones. Lower values produce more independent, scattered gullies.
erosionGullyWeight.label: Gully weight

erosionLacunarity.description: Frequency multiplier applied per octave. Controls how much smaller each successive detail layer is. A value of 2.0 means each octave is twice the frequency (half the feature size) of the previous.
erosionLacunarity.label: Erosion lacunarity

erosionNormalization.description: Degree of normalization applied to the Phacelle noise output. 0 = raw noise with amplitude variation across cells, 1 = fully normalized so all cells have equal amplitude. Intermediate values blend between the two.
erosionNormalization.label: Normalization

erosionOctaves.description: Number of FBM noise octaves layered together. More octaves add finer detail at the cost of performance. Each octave adds a smaller-scale layer of gullies on top of the previous ones. Range: 1..8.
erosionOctaves.label: Erosion octaves

erosionOnset.description: Slope thresholds that gate when erosion features appear. Each onset value acts as a sensitivity threshold -- lower values allow erosion to appear on flatter terrain, higher values restrict it to steeper slopes.
erosionOnset.label: Onset

erosionRounding.description: Controls how ridge tops and valley floors are rounded/smoothed. Higher rounding values produce smoother, more rounded terrain features at the erosion boundaries.
erosionRounding.label: Rounding

erosionScale.description: World-space feature size in meters. Controls the spatial scale of the largest erosion gullies. Larger values produce broader, more spread out gully patterns.
erosionScale.label: Erosion scale

erosionSlope.description: Controls how terrain slope is interpreted for gully direction. Blend between actual terrain slope and an assumed uniform slope to create more uniform erosion patterns on flat or gently sloping terrain.
erosionSlope.label: Assumed slope

erosionStrength.description: Overall amplitude of the erosion displacement effect. Controls how deep the gullies carve into the terrain. The value is divided by 1000 in the shader, so typical values are 0.1..1.0.
erosionStrength.label: Erosion strength

moundHeight.description: Raise/lower the ground around this stamp's own trunks.
moundHeight.label: Mound

moundTexture.description: Paint a terrain layer around this stamp's own trunks.
moundTexture.label: Trunk Texturing

noise.description: Procedural noise modulation for stamp weight.
noise.label: Noise

thinScreenSizeRange.description: Screen-size range for distance thinning (x=fully culled, y=fully visible).
thinScreenSizeRange.label: Thin Screen Size Range

loopDuration.description: Allows the effect to restart playing after a certain duration from when it initially started, default value of 0 means that there is no looping, if the effect duration is 1 second and this is 5 seconds, this mean that the effect will start to play every 5 seconds.
loopDuration.label: Loop Duration

playParams.description: Starts playback with these properties. The play params are synced across the network if the component is attached to a networked entity.
playParams.label: Playback Parameters

preserveTransformOnPlay.description: Allows the effect to keep an up-to-date previous position and velocity when it first starts playing, rather than teleporting to the current location with 0 velocity when play starts. This is disabled by default in order to avoid the performance impact of running updates when the effect is not active.
preserveTransformOnPlay.label: Preserve Transform On Play

asset.description: The video file asset to be played on the video screen.
asset.label: Asset

loop.description: If true, the video will loop. If false, the video will play once and then stop.
loop.label: Loop

playbackPositionMs.description: Playback position of the video in milliseconds (relative to start). Can be set anytime to seek to a specific position. Range: 0 (start) to video duration.
playbackPositionMs.label: Playback Position

sourceType.description: Source of the video. Right now only bundled videos are supported.
sourceType.label: Source Type

stereoFormat.description: Format of the video. Right now only mono is supported.
stereoFormat.label: Stereo Format

volume.description: Volume level for the video player. Range from 0.0 (muted) to 1.0 (maximum volume).
volume.label: Volume

mobileMeshAsset.description:
Mobile Mesh uses unlitBlend shader to render frame on the screen.
This is only used for Mobile screen. 
If not set, it will use the default mesh
mobileMeshAsset.label: Mobile Mesh Asset

mrMeshAsset.description:
MR Mesh uses holepunching to render frame on the screen.
This is only used for MR screen. 
If not set, it will use the default mesh
mrMeshAsset.label: MR Mesh Asset

renderOrderOffset.description: Adjusts the rendering order of the video screen mesh relative to other transparent objects in the scene. Higher values render later (on top). Use this to control layering when multiple transparent objects overlap
renderOrderOffset.label: Render Order Offset

screenType.description:
Could be rectilinear or immersive.
Rectilinear: Video is projected on a flat surface.
Immersive: Video is projected on a curved. Immersive screen will be supported in the future.
screenType.label: Screen Type

sortKey.description: Controls the compositor layer rendering order for immersive video screens. Lower values render first (farther back), higher values render later (closer to viewer).  Only applies to immersive screen types using compositor layers.
sortKey.label: Sort key

visibility.description: If true, the video screen will be visible. If false, the video screen will be hidden and need to called explicitly to be visible.
visibility.label: Is Visible

playerTemplateAsset.description: An instance of this template is spawned for each player in this world.
playerTemplateAsset.label: Player Template Asset

alignment.description: Sets alignment of multiple line text blocks.
alignment.label: Alignment

fontSize.description: Size in scene measurement units (meters by default).
fontSize.label: Font Size

lineSpacingMultiplier.description: Extra spacing between newlines (the font defined value is multiplied).
lineSpacingMultiplier.label: New Line Spacing Multiplier

outlineColor.description: Color value of the font outline.
outlineColor.label: Outline Color

outlineWidth.description: The size of the outline stroke.
outlineWidth.label: Outline Width

propColorLUTBrightness.description: This is a global shader constant packed into the w component of colorLUTEnabledSatContBright. To use it, a material must declare colorLUTEnabledSatContBright in its matParams constant buffer.
propColorLUTBrightness.label: Color LUT brightness

propColorLUTContrast.description: This is a global shader constant packed into the z component of colorLUTEnabledSatContBright. To use it, a material must declare colorLUTEnabledSatContBright in its matParams constant buffer.
propColorLUTContrast.label: Color LUT contrast

propColorLUTEnabled.description: This is a global shader constant packed into the x component of colorLUTEnabledSatContBright. To use it, a material must declare colorLUTEnabledSatContBright in its matParams constant buffer.
propColorLUTEnabled.label: Color LUT enabled

propColorLUTGain.description: This is a global shader constant packed into the xyz components of colorLUTGainHue. To use it, a material must declare colorLUTGainHue in its matParams constant buffer.
propColorLUTGain.label: Color LUT gain

propColorLUTGamma.description: This is a global shader constant stored as the xyz components of colorLUTGamma. To use it, a material must declare colorLUTGamma in its matParams constant buffer.
propColorLUTGamma.label: Color LUT gamma

propColorLUTHueShift.description: This is a global shader constant packed into the w component of colorLUTGainHue. To use it, a material must declare colorLUTGainHue in its matParams constant buffer.
propColorLUTHueShift.label: Color LUT hue shift

propColorLUTLift.description: This is a global shader constant stored as the xyz components of colorLUTLift. To use it, a material must declare colorLUTLift in its matParams constant buffer.
propColorLUTLift.label: Color LUT lift

propColorLUTSaturation.description: This is a global shader constant packed into the y component of colorLUTEnabledSatContBright. To use it, a material must declare colorLUTEnabledSatContBright in its matParams constant buffer.
propColorLUTSaturation.label: Color LUT saturation

propDirectLightingMultiplier.description: This is a global shader constant packed into the x component of directIndirectLightingMultiplier. To use it, a material must declare directIndirectLightingMultiplier in its matParams constant buffer.
propDirectLightingMultiplier.label: Direct lighting multiplier

propIndirectLightingMultiplier.description: This is a global shader constant packed into the y component of directIndirectLightingMultiplier. To use it, a material must declare directIndirectLightingMultiplier in its matParams constant buffer.
propIndirectLightingMultiplier.label: Indirect lighting multiplier

customFixedInteractionPromptIconTexture.description: Override the icon on the fixed interaction prompt. If not set, the default interactable icon will be used.
customFixedInteractionPromptIconTexture.label: Custom Icon Texture Asset

customInteractionPromptIconTexture.description: Override the icon on the interaction prompt. If not set, the default interactable icon will be used.
customInteractionPromptIconTexture.label: Custom Icon Texture Asset

enableFixedInteractionPrompt.description: Enable fixed positioning for the on-screen interaction prompt
enableFixedInteractionPrompt.label: Enable Fixed Interaction Prompt

enableHighlight.description: If enabled, the interactable will be highlighted with an outline when hovered over.
enableHighlight.label: Enable Highlight

enableTouch.description: Enable direct touch interaction on the entity
enableTouch.label: Enable Direct Touch

highlightColor.description: Color to highlight the interactable with when hovered
highlightColor.label: Highlight Color

highlightTargets.description: Reference entity meshes that will be highlighted in addition to the mesh on this entity.
highlightTargets.label: Highlight Targets

touchMaxDistance.description: Maximum distance for direct touch interaction (in meters)
touchMaxDistance.label: Direct Touch Max Distance
